feature_contract.goal: Bind actual game D3D9 programmable shader constants, vertex declarations and source buffers into native D3D11 Draw/DrawIndexed for complete menu, car selection and race frames while preserving exact fallback

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Real D3D9 VS and PS with their authored c registers and vertex streams issue a native D3D11 GPU Draw into the real game frame
Shader local DEF overrides external c registers, unsupported constants and matrix source states reject safely, original D3D9 game input and rendering continue
Constant and matrix translator source with positive and negative probes compiles with all five required Actions for one exact materialization SHA

integration_path: live D3D9 programmable shader pair and c/DEF state
stage-specific constant and matrix HLSL to DXBC materializer
actual D3D11 IA/VS/PS/OM Draw/DrawIndexed and full game output
batch_components: native_sm3_constant_codegen.hpp exact literal and matrix source emitter
